name: Spin 360E
summary: Compact, robust fully automatic clinical chemistry analyzer with a throughput of up to 360 tests per hour. Up to 100 sample and 100 refrigerated reagent positions, 12 wavelengths, a built-in barcode reader and an optional ISE module, backed by a dedicated line of ready-to-use Spinreact reagents.

specs.label: Calibration methods
specs.value: K factor, linear (two-point and multipoint), Logit-Log 3P/4P/5P, spline, exponential, polynomial, parabola, broken line

specs.label: Quality control
specs.value: Westgard multi-rule, Levey-Jennings, cumulative sum check, twin plot

specs.label: Ready-to-use tests
specs.value: ALB, HDL, LDL, CHOL, TGL, GLUC, UREA, J-CREA, T-CREA, U-ACID, T-BILI, D-BILI, T-PROT, U-PROT, AST, ALT, ALP, γ-GT, LDH, AMY, LIPASE, CHE, CK-NAC, CK-MB, Ca, Mg, P, Fe, Cl, APO A1, APO B, Lp(a), AT III, α-1-ATR, α-1-GLY, CER, HAPTO, TRANSF, FERR, C3, C4, IgA, IgG, IgM, IgE, CRP, ASO, RF, β-2-MICRO, µALB

features: Throughput of up to 360 tests per hour
Large, flexible capacity: up to 100 sample and 100 reagent positions
Intelligent probe with optional clog detection
Dedicated ready-to-use reagents reduce contamination and extend reagent life
